subject: LaboraTech onboarding: party matrix, template choice & initial redlines
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@laboratech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LaboraTech onboarding: party matrix, template choice & initial redlines

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, attaching our current MSA template and the SOW draft you shared. To keep momentum for next-week legal review, can you please: 

- Confirm the counterparty legal name and signer for the MSA (we have two entities in your org chart).
- Confirm the billing entity and the contact for invoicing (name and email).
- Tell us if any of your procurement policies require a PO number on invoices or special invoice cadence.
- Flag any non-negotiable terms for you (data residency, export controls, indemnity caps).

Our asks from Redwood side: 
- Kimberly: can you confirm which template variant we should apply for LaboraTech (Standard vs. Regulated)?
- Laura: please capture a signer map and whether we need an Exhibit for IP exclusions.

Expecting initial redline comments from your team by EOD Tuesday (14 Sep) so Legal can triage before we lock timelines. If you want a tracked redline instead of comments, let us know — we'll accept either.

Attachments: LaboraTech_SOW_v1.pdf (from you), Redwood_MSA_Template_v3.docx (from us).

Thanks,
Markus

--
Markus Klein
Head of Contracts Ops, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0147

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@laboratech.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@laboratech.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LaboraTech onboarding: party matrix, template choice & initial redlines

Thanks Markus — appreciate the clear list. Quick answers below and a couple of attachments.

- Counterparty legal name: LaboraTech, Inc. (Delaware) — signer: Elena Ruiz, VP Legal (unless required otherwise for >$1M commits).
- Billing entity: LaboraTech, Inc.; AP contact is accounts-payable@laboratech.com (cc'd in Proc distribution). They require PO numbers for orders over $50k and monthly net-30 payment terms.
- Procurement policy: we do require PO on invoice for orders >$50k; otherwise AP accepts email approvals.
- Non-negotiable items: data residency — customer data must remain in US/US-EU regions only (we may need residency clause), and restricted export controls on some datasets.

Attached: LaboraTech_SOW_v1.pdf (annotated, see pages 2-4 for scope changes) and a short procurement checklist (procurement_notes.txt). We'll aim to return a set of comments in tracked changes by 14 Sep; if we hit blockers earlier we'll flag them.

Forwarded for context: past standard MSA we used with partners (internal reference).

Best,
Elena

--
Elena Ruiz
VP Legal, LaboraTech, Inc.
elena@laboratech.com
+1 (650) 555-2209

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@laboratech.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LaboraTech onboarding: party matrix, template choice & initial redlines

Markus / Laura —

Thanks Elena for the quick turnaround and the procurement notes — helpful. My assessment: given the residency requirement and the fact this is a regulated customer, we should route to the Regulated template (Redwood_MSA_Template_v3-Regulated). Key flags for Legal to prioritize when we get their redlines: 

- Residency language: we will need to propose the specific region carve (US, EU regions) and an SLA for data segregation / export controls.
- Indemnity/cap: Elena indicated non-negotiable protections; we'll ask Product to confirm whether any functionality requires special export language.
- Billing/PO: finance confirmed we can accept PO but need the invoice flow updated (add PO field and net-30 notice).

Laura — can you start the signer map doc and set up a brief (15 min) sync for Monday to align on Exhibit needs? I can host.

Kimberly

--
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena@laboratech.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 17:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LaboraTech onboarding: party matrix, template choice & initial redlines

Great progress — looping back with a short plan: 

1) I started the signer map (attached stub in Drive) and will confirm the final list by Monday 09/13.
2) I'll prepare an Exhibit outline for IP/residency options (two variants: standard Exhibit vs. strict residency addendum) and share for internal review by 09/14.
3) Markus: once LaboraTech's tracked redlines arrive, I'll own the consolidation and produce a prioritized comment log for Legal (Kimberly) and Ops (Markus).

Elena — appreciate the target for 09/14. If procurement returns redlines earlier, we can accelerate the internal triage.

Thanks all — I'll send a calendar invite for a 15-min sync Monday morning (tentative).

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Contracts Program Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
